title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
A retired couple was defrauded of nearly $800,000 through a cryptocurrency investment scam that exploited the gradual building of trust. A scammer contacted one of them through WhatsApp, directed them to a mobile trading app, and showed them what appeared to be a legitimate trading interface. The key technical failure was a fake AI-generated website that displayed false account information, making profitable trades and successful withdrawals appear real until the victim attempted a larger withdrawal and discovered the funds were gone.

This was a deployment failure at the interface between a real trading app and fraudulent presentation layer. The scam succeeded because the victim saw what looked like genuine transaction confirmations and was able to withdraw smaller amounts, each success reinforcing confidence in the scheme. Catching this would have required either the victim to verify their account through an independent channel, or the trading platform to authenticate user access and account details through methods a fake website could not replicate.

It is not established whether the AI-generated website was created by the scammers themselves or obtained from another source, nor is the specific method by which false information was displayed on the victim's screen confirmed beyond the reporting.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
A retired Georgia couple lost nearly $800,000 in a sophisticated cryptocurrency scam that began when a stranger contacted Jerry Dunaway through WhatsApp. The scammer convinced Jerry to invest using a mobile trading app, and the scheme worked gradually by allowing him to make small trades, see positive returns, and successfully withdraw money, building his confidence over time. When Jerry tried to make a larger withdrawal, he discovered the funds were gone. Police explained that while the trading app was real, scammers had created a fake AI-generated website that displayed false account information on his screen.

Jerry and Mindy Dunaway are now speaking publicly to warn others about the sophisticated tactics used by these criminals. They have lost their entire life savings and are working with Gwinnett County police, though investigators say victims in these cases rarely recover their money. The couple's children have started a GoFundMe campaign to help them with daily expenses as they work to rebuild their lives.
